description: The assistant's provider key and the AI Guard rules it runs under.

fields.label: Enable AI Assistant
fields.description: Turns the assistant on for the users the AI Guard lets in.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Leave empty for the provider's default model.

fields.label: Company API Key
fields.description: Stored encrypted. Used by everyone who has not set a key of their own.

fields.label: Allow Personal API Keys
fields.description: Lets each user bring their own key, which their questions then use.

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: Only users with one of these roles may use the assistant. Leave empty to let every Books user in.

fields.label: Allow Proposed Changes
fields.description: Lets the assistant propose creating, changing and submitting records. Nothing is written until the user approves the change.

fields.label: Allow Deletes and Cancellations
fields.description: Lets the assistant propose deleting records and cancelling submitted documents.

fields.label: Hidden Record Types
fields.description: Record types the assistant may neither read nor change, whatever the user's own rights.

fields.label: Lookups per Question
fields.description: How many rounds of lookups one question may take before it is stopped.

fields.label: Rows per Lookup
fields.description: The most rows one lookup returns to the model.

name: Books AI Settings
